slides.title: Cover — AI Transformation for Education
slides.task_brief: Cover slide. Apply .brand-stripe (6px). Top-left: `` (260px wide) at top:64px/left:104px. Top-right: 'KEFI TECH · EDUCATION · 2026' in --text-muted. Center-left (~y=240): eyebrow 'KEFI TECH · EDUCATION' in --brand; display headline at --fs-display (64px) on two lines: line 1 'AI Transformation' in --primary, line 2 'for Education.' in --accent orange. Below: --accent-bar. Below: subtitle in --text-secondary at --fs-h3: 'A deep-tech capability brief on Kefi Tech AI Transformation Services for Education.' slides.title: Industry Context — Education
slides.task_brief: Industry context. Top-left: `KEFI TECH`. Top eyebrow 'INDUSTRY CONTEXT · EDUCATION' in --brand. Sora 700 headline 'Education is being reshaped by digital learning, institutional automation and student lifecycle intelligence.' Subtitle (--text-secondary): 'Student success, faculty productivity, institutional efficiency and digital experience define modern education.'. Below: TWO-COLUMN layout. LEFT (55%): .surface-elev panel (~560x360) titled 'WHY EDUCATION NEEDS THIS NOW' (eyebrow --brand). Below, 4 industry drivers as .surface cards with Material Icon (20px) + Sora 600 title (13px) + Inter 11px desc. 'trending_up' 'Digital transformation pressure' / 'Enterprise digital adoption accelerating across the industry.' 'shield' 'Regulatory & compliance demands' / 'Industry-specific regulations require continuous compliance technology.' 'speed' 'Operational efficiency mandate' / 'Cost-to-serve reduction while maintaining quality and resilience.' 'group' 'Customer & employee expectations' / 'Modern digital experiences are now table stakes, not differentiation.' RIGHT (45%): .surface-elev panel (~440x360) titled 'WHAT THIS MEANS FOR AI TRANSFORMATION' (eyebrow --accent-dark). Below, Inter 13px --text-secondary (line-height 1.7): 'AI Transformation applied to education requires industry-specific capability, not generic technology. The right approach connects ai transformation to the regulatory, operational and customer realities that define education.' Below body: .tag-pill 'INDUSTRY-SPECIFIC APPROACH' in --brand-soft. Bottom rail (.bordered): left text wordmark; center '02 / 12'; right 'EDUCATION CONTEXT'.

slides.title: Engagement Pathway
slides.task_brief: Engagement pathway. Top-left: text wordmark. Top eyebrow 'ENGAGEMENT PATHWAY' in --brand. Sora 700 headline 'A four-stage pathway from discovery to managed operations.' Subtitle (--text-secondary): 'Each stage carries concrete deliverables, fixed duration, and transparent commercial frame.' 4-column grid of FOUR .pathway-stage cards (~270x360, gap-4). Apply .pathway-stage.accent to card 4. Each card: .pathway-stage-num + .pathway-stage-name + .pathway-stage-meta + hairline-soft + 'DELIVERABLES' + list + .pathway-stage-fee. STAGE 01 'Discovery' meta '2 WEEKS · FIXED FEE'. Deliverables: 'AI Transformation maturity assessment', 'Opportunity prioritization', '90-day roadmap', 'ROI business case'. Fee: '$25K-$75K'. STAGE 02 'Solution Design' meta '3-4 WEEKS · FIXED FEE'. Deliverables: 'Target architecture', 'CoE charter', 'Governance framework', 'Build plan'. Fee: '$50K-$150K'. STAGE 03 'Delivery' meta '8-24 WEEKS · T&M OR FIXED'. Deliverables: 'Production system', 'Integration complete', 'Documentation', 'Knowledge transfer'. Fee: '$300K-$1M'. STAGE 04 'Managed Operations' meta 'ONGOING · RETAINER'. Deliverables: 'Managed services', 'Continuous optimization', 'Quarterly reviews', 'SLA-backed operations'. Fee: '$50K-$500K / mo'. NO pull-quote. NO CTA. Bottom rail (.bordered): text wordmark; center '10 / 12'; right 'ENGAGEMENT PATHWAY'.
